lessons.finding: The offset bracket overhangs the end of the 2x10 plate. The 1x2 bottom plate at X=-110,Y=0 lies outside the base footprint, not intersecting it.
99780 up at Y=-8 and 99781 down at Y=-40 put side-stud rows at Y=-10 and -30, exactly one stud pitch apart; check stud rows to distinguish similar brackets.
The central upright with blank front foot is 41682 centered bracket, not 99780. Its side row is 10 LDU above the part origin.
4304 has two stud levels. 3020 is supported by its lower row, while 11211 is over the higher row; side studs then align exactly 20 LDU apart.
Lower-leg skins mount on Z sides, leaving green X+ stud face for knee and long exterior plate. Step 280 is 2x8 3034, verified by enlarged BOM stud count; do not infer plate length from perspective.

Adjacent caps shown in one view can attach on perpendicular planes: 286 uses the end-facing 4304 raised stud row, while 287 uses the underside of the long base plate. Read the reverse-view icon and visible antistuds before assigning one shared surface normal.

L-section green67329 end faces at localZ220 transform to lower-legZ-20, with stud gridX30/50,Y-270/-250. They align with lower-leg side studsX-10/10 on the sameZ-20 plane. Thus3072639 topZ-28 is correct: do not change306 roll merely because a different camera makes the cover appear behind the knee.
